motion.reduced_motion: Ensure `prefers-reduced-motion` limits animations to simple opacity crossfades without translation or scaling.

accessibility.aria_labels: All selector buttons must have aria-label corresponding to the car year and model. Navigation arrows must have aria-label 'Previous Car' and 'Next Car'.

media.handling: Images must be preloaded. Use object-cover for full width impact. The image should sit horizontally centered, clipped deliberately by viewport bounds to feel monumental.

instructions_to_main_agent: This component must be a 100svh fixed viewport (no internal vertical scrolling) with `overflow-hidden`.
Maintain the 7 requested cars: 2007 McLaren MP4-22, 2008 McLaren MP4-23, 2014 Mercedes W05, 2018 Mercedes W09, 2019 Mercedes W10, 2020 Mercedes W11, 2025 Ferrari SF-25.
Implement a data structure containing: model, year, team, wins, podiums, poles, championship outcome, power unit, chassis concept, and a concise significance story for each car.
Use Framer Motion's `AnimatePresence` to handle switching between cars. The active car's image and data mount/unmount seamlessly. No infinite framer loops.
Implement keyboard navigation: `ArrowLeft` and `ArrowRight` to switch cars. Ensure event listeners are properly managed.
Add a compact, mobile-scrollable 7-car selector timeline at the bottom of the screen.
Implement an image preloader hook/effect that loads all 7 car images quietly in the background when the component mounts to preserve transition performance.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn cards. Use raw Tailwind divs with explicit Z-indices to layer the background text, car image, and foreground stats.
Use `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements: `data-testid='car-selector-button-{year}'`, `data-testid='prev-car-button'`, `data-testid='next-car-button'`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the custom Typography scale.
Do not add universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Only transition specific properties.
Never center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Use strict left-aligned typography for readability.
Ensure layered design elements with explicit z-index hierarchy.
Add subtle noise overlays or gradients ONLY if it enhances depth, but do not use simplistic full-screen CSS gradients.
All missing assets must use provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image APIs.
